brief.title: ClassSpot Waitlist
brief.customer: Members and managers of independent fitness studios
brief.problem: Members miss class spots when someone cancels at short notice.
brief.solution: An opt-in alert when a space opens, with a way to claim it.
brief.known: One studio manager described the problem. No member use or payment data was collected.

assumptions.statement: The booking feed reports class cancellations quickly enough to alert members.
assumptions.reason: A stale alert can arrive after the space is gone.
assumptions.query: fitness studio booking cancellation webhook delivery

assumptions.statement: Members who use one alert will claim another spot without a reminder.
assumptions.reason: Repeat use shows whether the waitlist serves a recurring need.

assumptions.statement: An existing studio tool does not already let members claim an opening from a cancellation alert.
assumptions.reason: The claim flow is the proposed reason to choose ClassSpot.
assumptions.query: studio software cancellation waitlist claim alerts

assumptions.statement: Studio managers will pay a separate monthly fee for this service.
assumptions.reason: Studios need to cover the cost of operating the waitlist.
assumptions.query: fitness studio waitlist software monthly pricing

assumptions.statement: The first version can support one booking system without custom work for each studio.
assumptions.reason: Custom integrations would extend the pilot setup.

repeat_use.title: Test a second voluntary waitlist claim
repeat_use.procedure: Invite 8 members who claimed a pilot opening to use the same waitlist for 7 days. Send opening alerts only. Record a second claim for each participant.
repeat_use.metric: Members who claim a second opening without a separate usage reminder.
repeat_use.threshold: Continue if at least 4 of 8 claim again. Otherwise interview members who did not return.
repeat_use.cost: Two hours of studio coordination plus any compensation

delivery.title: Measure cancellation delivery delay
delivery.procedure: Stage 10 cancellations in a test booking account during peak hours and record elapsed time before each event is received.
delivery.threshold: Continue with the webhook if at least 9 of 10 arrive within 60 seconds. Otherwise test another booking feed.
delivery.cost: A test booking account and one developer hour

alternatives.title: Check competing cancellation-to-claim flows
alternatives.procedure: Inspect the test accounts or product walkthroughs of the 3 booking systems most common among 5 local studios.
alternatives.metric: Alternatives that provide a direct claim link in a cancellation alert.
alternatives.threshold: If at least 1 of 3 has this feature, interview studios about what their current workflow still misses.
alternatives.cost: Trial access and three hours of research
